column1: # Build targets: what can be built, and on which architectures.
# Consumed by targets.sh and build-in-container.sh. Columns are tab-separated:
#   id            short name, used as `build-in-container.sh <id>`
#   format        rpm | deb | arch
#   image         container image supplying the DISTRIBUTION
#   arches        architectures this target is built for
# The container supplies the distribution; the host supplies the architecture.
# An arm64 package is built on arm64 hardware, never cross-compiled or emulated,
# so cgo and shared-library dependency generation stay correct.
# The RPM set matches the spec's own "Supported distributions" line. Each of
# their default repositories satisfies the spec's BuildRequires: golang >= 1.24.
# That golang only bootstraps the build: %build fetches the toolchain go.mod pins.
# debian uses a Go-provided image rather than plain debian:bookworm: bookworm's
# golang-go is 1.19, too old even to fetch the go.mod toolchain, and
# debian/control deliberately declares no Go build-dependency for exactly that
# reason. The result is still a bookworm-built package -- only the toolchain
# differs.
# Images are fully qualified. A short name like fedora:latest resolves per engine
# and per machine: docker always reads it as docker.io, podman consults the
# local registries.conf aliases and refuses an ambiguous name outright when it
# cannot prompt, as in CI. A qualified name pins which registry supplies the
# distribution, so a local build and a CI build of the same id use one image.
# CI builds every row on every listed architecture: .github/workflows/packages.yml
# reads this file through `targets.sh json`, so a new row is a new CI leg.
# id              format  image                                        arches
fedora            rpm     registry.fedoraproject.org/fedora:latest     amd64,arm64
rhel9             rpm     registry.access.redhat.com/ubi9/ubi          amd64,arm64
rhel10            rpm     registry.access.redhat.com/ubi10/ubi         amd64,arm64
amazonlinux2023   rpm     public.ecr.aws/amazonlinux/amazonlinux:2023  amd64,arm64
debian-bookworm   deb     docker.io/library/golang:1.26-bookworm       amd64,arm64
arch              arch    docker.io/library/archlinux:latest           amd64
